thread:
Anya (PM): Heads-up: Billing help panel uses 'rate limits' but the docs and billing UI use 'quota' elsewhere. Customers in onboarding asked if they're the same thing. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/ux-bill-01 :confused:
Devin (Design): yikes. that's confusing. i'd prefer 'quota' as canonical term (matches invoices and API). can update the panel microcopy.
Carmen (Docs): confirmed: docs canonical is 'quota' after the last glossary sweep. happy to add a short clarifying sentence and canonical link.
Noah (Frontend): impl note: help panel title lives in the shared help component, CTA label in billing flow. small change but saved permalinks need mapping. also add ?utm=console-help for analytics.
Liu (A11y): accessibility items: ensure the help panel heading is programmatically announced and that the link text describes the target (e.g., 'Read quota docs (opens in new tab)'). focus should return to the trigger button.
Devin (Design): proposed microcopy: Button -> 'Set quota', Panel title -> 'Quota docs', Body -> 'Quotas limit API usage and billing tiers. See examples and how-to adjust limits.' Add note: 'Previously shown as rate limits in older UIs.'
Anya (PM): action items: Devin PR microcopy, Noah to add mapping + utm, Carmen to update docs and add legacy note, Liu to validate aria/focus. I'll open a tiny RFC and tag #billing #console for signoff.
reminder-bot: reminder set for #console-checkin Friday 11:00 to confirm rollout :bell:
Carmen (Docs): will push the docs update and include cross-link to the in-product panel.
Noah (Frontend): will schedule QA for saved links and tests. target next patch.
Liu (A11y): will run quick screen reader pass after merge and report regressions.
Anya (PM): thanks team 680
